assumptions.statement: Explicit micro/macro dynamics, coarse and lift maps, a gauge and finite queries exist.
Closed macro dynamics require equality of the induced next coarse state on every fiber; a lift alone is not an inverse.
Retained detail and an error ledger support finite advance and re-refinement without inventing lost information.
Future models may learn scale-changing interfaces; the material metaphor implies no physical substance or conservation law.

obligations: Query equivalence is relative to the declared finite query family.
Response outside its radius requests refresh; nonclosed scales require retained detail or added statistics.

error_ledger.local_response_status: outside declared trust region; refresh anchor
